stem.text: A moving source emits sound of frequency $1200\,\text{Hz}$.
A stationary observer hears sound of frequency $960\,\text{Hz}$. The speed of the sound is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What could be the velocity of the source?

A.text: $68\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ directly away from the observer

C.text: $85\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ directly away from the observer
